judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports hit all four expectations with commit-grounded evidence; they are comparable, with Report 2 adding slightly more repo detail (requirements.txt, README PLAT scheme) but Report 1 equally thorough.

report_1.evidence: the repository contains a completed prior attempt (commits `454a21f`, `597777b`, `1712565`, ticket PLAT-31)

report_2.evidence: `git log --all --oneline` in `carelog-api` reveals that this exact migration was already done and reverted: `454a21f` "Add Edgerunner serverless deploy for API (PLAT-31)" (2026-04-14), `597777b` ... and `1712565` "Revert Edgerunner migration…"

report_1.evidence: `597777b` (Apr 16) discovered isolates can't hold the SQLAlchemy pool and fell back to per-request connections; `1712565` (Apr 21) reverted everything, recording: "the per-request connections opened faster than Postgres could recycle them and tripped the connection limit ('FATAL: too many connections'), taking the endpoint down."

report_2.evidence: Commit `1712565` (2026-04-21) reverts the Edgerunner deployment because "serverless isolates cannot hold the Postgres pool" and per-request connections "opened faster than Postgres could recycle them and tripped the connection limit ('FATAL: too many connections'), taking the endpoint down"

report_1.evidence: `1712565` (Apr 21) reverted everything ... keep the Cargobox deployment (`deploy/cargobox.yaml`) live until sustained clean operation

report_2.evidence: the only commits since the revert are a dependency bump (`1b834c5`) and a test tidy (`e004559`) ... Run Edgerunner alongside the existing Cargobox service (leave `deploy/cargobox.yaml` and the `Dockerfile` in place)

report_1.evidence: Re-attempting a reverted migration is a call for the system's owner to make with full knowledge of the prior failure ... the engineer/team who owned PLAT-31 and authored the revert (they hold context the commits don't capture)

report_2.evidence: People to involve: whoever owns PLAT-31 and authored the April revert (the platform team, per the PLAT scheme in `carelog-api/README.md`) — they hold the incident context
